     4

     6	served library (`bootstrap.loadLibrary` → `library.setDataset`), whose clamp keeps the embedded day. A shell built on one day and opened
     7	on a later one therefore shows the shell's day, not the latest completed day. `thesis-ui.md`: "The supplied snapshot defines the
     8	displayed date."
     9	
    10	**Rule:** the library has no date control of its own (its day is set only when it is created and in `setDataset`, searched); the
    11	person changes dates in the explorer and the drawer, which keep their own state. So: the page's one automatic read
    12	(`bootstrap.loadLibrary`, run once at start) shows the served snapshot's `as_of`; every other replacement keeps today's verified clamp
    13	(`verify-library.mjs`, "library day clamps before replacement"); a failed read keeps the embedded snapshot silently, as
    14	`thesis-ui.md` specifies ("Automatic API loading keeps the current snapshot when unavailable"), a limitation recorded for Alex.
    15	
    16	**Owner:** `components/library.js` `setDataset(input, { day } = {})`: with a day, the library shows it, clamped to the new history;
    17	without, today's behaviour. `bootstrap.loadLibrary` passes `{ day: next.as_of }`. `thesis-ui.md` says it.
    18	
    19	**Proof ($0):** a test of `setDataset` with and without `{ day }`; the existing clamp check unchanged; the paused-writer test re-run
    20	with the page check asserting the displayed day and the question identities against the served response; the production shell against
    21	a new-system store shows the served `as_of`.

    26	views serve the day in progress. **Readers of that default** (searched): `bundle.library`, `bundle.thesis_bundles`, `idea.py`,
    27	`search.py`, `service.py` (views, a view, evidence, history, changes, the day's items, the evaluation route), and MCP's start
    28	(`scripts/hivemind_mcp.py`, the object list). Changing the default would change every one of them; a `None` default breaks several that
    29	compare dates. Census: 0 of 143 stored `views.sqlite` files hold processing steps, judgements and no completed day; the state lasts
    30	only from a new store's first write to the end of its first day.
    31	
    32	**Enforced at the two entry points (built):** `service.first_day_unfinished(conn)` is true when a store records processing steps and
    33	no completed day. `scripts/hivemind_api.py` and `scripts/hivemind_mcp.py` refuse to start on such a store, with a message naming the
    34	rule; a legacy ledger with no day records (no steps) starts as before. A crash that leaves a store in that state is refused the same

    36	default of every reader stays as it is. Tests through the real entry points: the API started as a process on a temporary store with a
    37	step and no completed day exits with the refusal; with a completed day it serves `/days`; the MCP server on the first store exits with
    38	the refusal. `docs/poc/service.md` states the rule.

item.text:
**No-go on B’s startup-only guard; A is ready to build.** The guard can pass before the first processing record exists, then leave the server running while the writer reaches exactly the partial state it is meant to block.

The clean writer creates and commits an empty store first. It later writes article processing records and commits them before judging and completing the first day. If the API starts in that initial interval, `first_day_unfinished` would be false; after the first judgement, the existing default can expose the unfinished day. Completed days growing monotonically does not close that startup race. [ladder_adapter.py](/Users/lchingen/hivemind/clean-arch/step4-2026-11-10/stage_b/ladder_adapter.py:164), [daily loop](/Users/lchingen/hivemind/clean-arch/step4-2026-11-10/stage_b/ladder_adapter.py:352)

Revise B to identify the intended live-store mode and refuse or withhold reads until its first day completes, including when the service starts **before** the first processing record. Keep legacy compatibility explicit. Test the real API starting on the empty store, then advance the writer through a first judgement and first completion; exercise MCP’s corresponding path too. Also record the crash-left state without saying it necessarily ends when the first day would have completed. [LIVE-READ-DESIGN.md](/Users/lchingen/hivemind/docs/research/2026-11-14-use-acceptance/page-contract/LIVE-READ-DESIGN.md:23)

A now matches the actual library interface: the initial successful load can select the served `as_of`, while later replacements keep the clamp. The delayed user-date case was correctly removed.

CONSENSUS: no, because the startup-only guard can admit an empty store that subsequently becomes an unfinished first-day store.
